what_it_pays_for: You put up to 80 videos behind a one-off paywall and viewers buy access. Unlike gifts and rewards this is paid for the content itself, so a small audience that really wants the material can outperform a large one that does not.
additional_requirements_not_assessed: Must be 18 years or older, or 19 in South Korea.
Must have a public Personal or Business Account; political and private accounts are not eligible.
Account must be in good standing with no repeated Community Guidelines violations.
